title: Full Retrofit Roadmap: Planning, Grants & Execution
summary: How to plan, budget, and execute a comprehensive home energy retrofit in Ireland with full SEAI grant support.

sections.heading: Planning Your Retrofit Journey
body: A single comprehensive retrofit plan unlocks maximum grant efficiency.
A successful deep retrofit combines insulation, heat pump technology, microgeneration solar PV, and mechanical ventilation to deliver A-rated comfort and minimal running costs.
sections.pullquote: A single comprehensive retrofit plan unlocks maximum grant efficiency.
